shared_elements: horizontal border band along the top edge
row of repeated ornamental motifs beneath the band
shallow relief carving with closely ruled vertical striations/fluting
elongated vertical forms with a flaring or crowned upper end
justification: Both surfaces place a plain horizontal band along the upper edge with a row of repeated, regularly spaced motifs suspended beneath it, and both render their forms as elongated vertical shapes filled with fine parallel striations (the pleated garment in A, the ribbed shafts in B). The decisive difference is subject: A depicts a single large standing human figure in profile holding an upright spear, a figural scene, whereas B shows only an abstract or vegetal repeating ornament with no figure, creature or narrative content at all.
